cards.rationale: Golden Boy's official event page and The Ring confirm a 12-round middleweight main event; a Boxing Only preview says 10 rounds, so that conflicting secondary listing is not used. The Ring ranks Jones No. 6 at middleweight and records 17-0 with 15 KOs, coming off a patient third-round stoppage of former champion Vincenzo Gualtieri. Independent previews describe him as a switch-hitter with sharp combinations, a jab, and varied head/body attacks. The best evidence is his full-distance loss to unbeaten Jordan Panthen, but the independent scorecards were wide (100-90, 98-92, 97-93), not a near-upset; his last four all went to the cards and he last fought Dec. 6, 2025. The last verified direct BetUS method market remains Jones KO/TKO/DQ -830 versus a five-outcome no-vig fair near -333. The quote was not directly refreshed in this pass and the exact internal snapshot event is unmatched. The price is too short; PASS.
